description: This file defines a custom exception class `AccountingRuleInvalidException` used in the accounting rule module of the Fineract project. It includes an inner enum `GlClosureInvalidReason` that specifies reasons for invalid GL closures, such as future date and accounting closed. The exception is thrown when an accounting rule validation fails due to these reasons.
external_methods: AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException's constructor `super(String errorCode, String errorMessage, LocalDate date)`
